This led to incorrect assumptions about visible faces and projection behavior. It also failed to consider that 'side faces' in the context of a parallel 2D projection refers to counting exposed faces along projection rays from different viewing directions (X/Y axes), not just the four cardinal sides of a single cube. The model’s reasoning collapsed at the perception stage, which cascaded into flawed spatial and counting logic.
